packageRules.description: The SDK lower bound is a caret range; move the range itself, not a lockfile.
A new Dart or Flutter minor arrives as one PR labelled sdk-update. The sdk-update workflow adds every new rule with a decision to that PR.
Dart patch releases do not change rules; raising the lower bound for them would only lock consumers out.
Flutter patch releases only move the exact pin the example app is tested with.
analyzer is pinned to the version bundled with the SDK and moved by the sdk-update workflow, never to latest.
